description: ospgrillage provides a Python interface for creating and analysing bridge-deck grillage models with OpenSeesPy. Its contributors publish a preprocessor that defines deck meshes, materials, supports and loading cases, or exports Python commands for further editing in OpenSeesPy. Documented element choices include elastic and Timoshenko beams and shells. Moving loads, result envelopes and xarray-based outputs support inspection of displacement and force components. Coverage is a user-defined bridge deck; no fixed geographic area, observation period or mesh resolution is supplied. GitHub and PyPI distribute the MIT-licensed code free of charge. Limitations include the model idealisation and supported element and load definitions; OpenSeesPy remains a required underlying solver. The tool can support bridge-load studies and comparisons of structural configurations. Related record model-opensees is the underlying analysis system, not a duplicate of this dedicated preprocessor. Documentation was reviewed without generating or running a bridge model.
